title.narrative: Significant progress has been achieved with this output. In line with the UNICEF SCAP, LCO has engaged during 2023 in system strengthening work targeting the WASH and Climate sector to ensure that children are protected against the impact of climate change but are also empowered to act. Several system strengthening initiatives were successfully completed including capacity building events, high level advocacy for child-sensitive climate and water policies, sector coordination support etc. UNICEF continues to empower youth to turn them into activists for climate action in Libya in collaboration with Ministries of Environment and Youth as well as local Youth-led CSOs.;;;
